Resolves #21397
Related: #17692, #20061, #20344

Pre-warms every open `dev` PR once (`pulls.get` bounded by `MERGEABILITY_CONCURRENCY`, consumed as `restart === 0`'s `seed`) before polling on multi-PR board sweeps, adjusts `.github/workflows/review-admission-mergeability.yml` bounded `mergeable` polling from 4 sub-second attempts (~`1.75s`) to `7` attempts with capped exponential backoff (`2s` -> `30s` cap, `90s` per PR; `1 + 32 * 12 = 385` REST calls worst-case on a 32-PR single-pass null sweep under the 1,000 req/hr repository `GITHUB_TOKEN` budget), retries when `finalPull` carries a late boolean verdict with restarts remaining, and publishes `review-admission/mergeability` `state: 'pending'` (plus `core.warning` on `pull_request_target` instead of `core.setFailed`) when bounded polls exhaust at `mergeable: null`.

Declared change class: `restoration` (`fix`). `agent-preflight: not hosted here`; local staged husky + unit checks ran on commit `05432c0030` (`check-guard-ci-parity`, `check-derived-domain`, `check-shorthand`, `check-whitespace`, `check-jsdoc-types`, `check-block-alignment`, `check-parse`, `check-fixed-sleeps`, `neo-agent-skills-secrets`, `neo-agent-skills-ticket-archaeology`).

Evidence: L2 (Playwright unit spec executing inline `actions/github-script` workflow runtime) -> L2 required (AC-1..AC-4).

## Deltas from ticket

- Checked `typeof finalPull.mergeable === 'boolean' && restart < maxRestarts` specifically so any non-boolean/unsupported `mergeable` value still hits the type guard or pending fallback instead of looping blindly.

- `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/ReviewAdmissionMergeability.spec.mjs` on commit `05432c0030`: `10 passed (423ms)`. Full CI checks re-running on `05432c0030`.

- [ ] Observe the next `dev` pushes under concurrent open-PR recomputation latency (such as `#21365` / `#21347` specimens in runs `44381785167` / `44383820390`) to confirm `review-admission/mergeability` either settles cleanly inside the pre-warm + poll budget or holds at `pending` with zero false `repair-ci` open-work wakes and well inside the 1,000 req/hr REST limit.
- [ ] Count open PR heads still holding at `review-admission/mergeability=pending` one hour after a board sweep to confirm whether quiet stretches leave unresolved heads stranded without a follow-up trigger.
